description: Every framework plugin that is planned but not built yet. Built plugins are found from their plugin@1 manifests (apps/*/plugins/<folder>/plugin.json), so an entry here turns to built by itself once a plugin with the same id exists. Installed = built and enabled in the app looking at the list. Check: node framework/cli/plugins.mjs --check

items.name: Asset Designer (no-code)
items.description: No-code designer for drawers, layouts, style packs and colour themes (menus and toolbars moved to the UI asset designer and its add-ons, build ui-asset-designer, Nov 7 2026).

items.name: Asset Browser
items.description: Browse, preview and swap every asset of every type.

items.name: axHub adapter for AXF
items.description: axHub-side plugin (axhub-adapter-axf) that plugs AXF apps into axHub; lives in this repo.

items.name: UI asset designer
items.description: Host plugin (designer@1): creates UI assets with their designed@1 manifest and identifier, registers them in the asset library and the UI registry, and inherits every installed designer add-on (app menu, nav menu, toolbar, banner, embed, widget) with a shared canvas, context menu, drag and drop, undo and live preview.

items.name: App menu designer
items.description: Standalone designer add-on for app-menu assets: menus, items, separators, submenus, live lists; works alone and inside the UI asset designer.

items.name: Nav menu designer
items.description: Standalone designer add-on for nav-menu assets: sections, items, sub menus, nav-style; works alone and inside the UI asset designer.

items.name: Toolbar designer
items.description: Standalone designer add-on for toolbar assets: groups, buttons, live lists, widgets, dropped hooks and embeds, placement; works alone and inside the UI asset designer.

items.name: Banner designer
items.description: Standalone designer add-on for banner assets: attachments per side, widgets, badges, embeds, height and surface; works alone and inside the UI asset designer.

items.name: Embed designer
items.description: Standalone designer add-on for embed assets (embed-asset@1): target picked from the UI registry tree, manifest link, size, hosts, sandbox; works alone and inside the UI asset designer.

items.name: Widget designer
items.description: Standalone designer add-on for every widget type (clock, search bar, logo, label, status, counter, progress, avatar, link, theme switch, spacer, divider): fields from the asset type, live preview; works alone and inside the UI asset designer.
